description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of Land in Meemure, Ududumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically deals with land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing details about compensation deposited for a particular land parcel (Gonnagolle Chena) including its description, plan number, lot number, extent, and location. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns property acquisition and compensation procedures.
